node.title: Rank-eleven low-span residual payment
node.closure: unsafe rank-eleven survivors require collective nontransverse correction span at least seven
node.statement: At the official KoalaBear post-near affine-error-rank-eleven interface, select tau=1549 and h=42451 in the anchored row-space router. The complete transverse envelope is 274947501264373505. If the span V_nt of every represented nontransverse rank-one/rank-two row space had dimension at most six, ordinary affine-span plus sub-square two-fold interleaving would cap all nontransverse pair types by M_6=floor(C(n-K+6,6)/C(A-K+6,6))=16190045 and their slopes by R_6=(n-A)M_6=15909196289385. The total 274963410460662890 is below B_*=274980728111395087 by 17317650732197. Therefore every unsafe line has dim(V_nt)>=7. Quantitatively its nontransverse mass is at least 33226847021583, forcing at least 134181 represented row spaces and, after canonical promotion/merge, at least 8406 distinct dimension-two/three rich containers, each with at least 42452 common actual zero coordinates. The adjacent h=42452 envelope exceeds budget by 1804196591101; this is a payment wall, not an unsafe witness.
